answer: Terrace consensus routing requires agents to deposit stake into a glacier lock vault before participating in gossip propagation. Subnet monitors track routing graphs so unverified nodes cannot wander across clusters without valid zero-knowledge transit proofs. Collusion triggers 100% bond slashing (50% burned, 50% paid to reporters) plus a 10-epoch ban. An attacker launching 1,000 sybils must risk 20,000,000 POA (1,000 x 20,000 POA bond), whereas an honest node stakes 20,000 POA once. Heavy deposit requirements impose severe cold-start friction on new agents.
